name: Prism Finance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Prism Finance Ltd is in the business of Finance and Investments[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) PFL is a Non Deposit taking Non Systematically Important Non-Banking Financial Company 
b) Company is in the business of financial services providing finance via loans, advances, Bill discounting, Lease, Higher Purchase and any other form of finance. It also makes investment in Shares & Securities, trading and dealing in Shares & Securities

pros: Stock is trading at 0.73 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.22% over last 3 years.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
